title: Default-on optional syntax for parser-free terminal hosts
purpose: Resolve the actual tree-sitter native-links collision without migrating Norn/Chiron or adding parser startup/caches to its plain-text composer.
task: Preserve the reviewed and locally verified parser-free terminal feature in the authorized private branch checkpoint. The actual Git revision and push verification are recorded externally after commit; no main or venue/Fable landing claim.

requirements.title: Explicit TUI syntax feature and parser-free rendering
requirements.spec: Implement D16. Feature-select only actual syntax dependencies/state/mapping/tests. Use the existing plain Palette style and existing shared geometry/selection/search/caret paint logic when syntax is absent. No unused-argument workarounds, simulated cache or silent fallback. No editor kernel modifications.
acceptance: TUI default feature enables syntax; no-default TUI/editor dependency graph contains no iridium-syntax or tree-sitter packages. Optional Rope dependency is selected only by syntax; Frame is zero-sized without it.

Both complete cargo test --locked -p iridium-tui and --no-default-features pass; all existing public composer/primary-caret fixtures run in both scopes. New feature fixture verifies fixed text styles with/without syntax, language auto-pairs, Unicode paste and history.
Both corresponding all-targets cargo clippy selections pass with -D warnings; cargo fmt --all -- --check passes. Exact source before/after and log witnesses; no old assembled proof reused as new.
Existing syntax cache ownership/equal-counter/divergent-clone tests remain present and execute by default. Feature-specific test census is recorded, not called ignored/skipped green.
Existing Rust syntax benchmark declares required-features syntax; no parser-free Rust timing claim.

No editor/Norn/Chiron tree-sitter migration, no added mapping authority, no changed default colors or parser behavior. Each production file stays under its registered local size limit; legacy test inventory remains separate.

boundaries: Exactly10 modified TUI files and one new public integration test; no kernel source, Cargo.lock version churn or Norn source. Additional paths require a registered amendment.
Root authorizes dedicated ICC CPU cache jobs2 for both scopes. No GPU/workspace expansion, main, public action or installation. Commit/push only after actual checks.
verification: Render and coverage before source edit.
Current feature-specific tests/strictClippy/fmt and graph proof before the actual private Git pin.
